source_gaps: The FTC alerts give no line telling readers to hang up or refuse to send money on a family emergency call, so none is stated as a rule. The 2018 FTC blog 'Talking turkey' (ftc.gov/node/54353) was checked but only fragments of its sentences could be verified, so it is not used. The 2023 alert's line on wire, cryptocurrency and gift card requests was truncated on the page, so it is not used. No phone number for the FTC is used beyond ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
